sentences.en: A niece is a daughter of one's brother or sister.
sentences.zh: 侄女是你的兄弟或姐妹的女儿。

sentences.en: I play a lot with my cousins, nieces and nephews.
sentences.zh: 我经常和堂兄弟、堂姐妹以及侄子侄女们一起玩。

sentences.en: Why did you bring on your niece to live here?
sentences.zh: 你为什么把你侄女带来住在这里？

senses.zh: 侄女，外甥女，教士的私生女
